description_en: Creates a list of vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed. After the list is created, you can select the list when you create a vulnerability fixing task on the Playbook page
description_zh: 批量创建可自动修复的漏洞列表，创建后用于任务中心的漏洞修复任务的漏洞列表选择
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-vul-auto-repair-config --type cve --vul-auto-repair-config-list AliasName=CVE-2018-25032:zlib_1.2.11_memory_corruption Name=anolisos:8.4:ANSA-2022:0001 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVulAutoRepairConfig

parameters.help_en: The type of the vulnerability. Valid values: -cve: Linux software vulnerability -sys: Windows system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值：
-cve：Linux软件漏洞
-sys：Windows系统漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed
parameters.help_zh: 可自动修复的漏洞列表
parameters.name: vul_auto_repair_config_list

parameters.help_en: The reason why the vulnerability can be automatically fixed
parameters.help_zh: 添加可自动化修复漏洞的原因说明
parameters.name: reason

Code.description_en: The status code returned. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other status codes indicate that the request failed. You can identify the cause of the failure based on the status code
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：

true：是
false：否
